item.title: Americans sweep Group A with dominating 5-0 win over Canada
item.description: MILAN (AP) — Hannah Bilka scored twice, and the United States’ youth and speed overwhelmed a Canadian women’s hockey team missing its captain in a 5-0 win at the Milan Cortina Games on Tuesday.
